step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage double-balanced quadrature mixer. It uses a shared RF transconductance stage and cross-coupled switching quads to generate In-phase (I) and Quadrature (Q) IF outputs. Notably, one of the switching quads utilizes a complementary CMOS switch (NMOS/PMOS pair) to allow single-ended LO driving, saving LO power.

paper_reference.title: A 1.2-mW RDS Receiver for Portable Applications

Conversion Gain.description: Voltage gain from the differential RF input to the differential IF output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = (2/pi) * gm * Rload. With Id=200uA per branch, gm is approx 2mS. Using 1k ohm load resistors, Gain ~ 1.26 V/V = 2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The gain is heavily dependent on the chosen load resistors (1k ohm used in testbench) and the tail current.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the mixer core.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for the 1.8V supply in SKY130 compared to the 0.9V supply used in the original paper.

I/Q Phase Difference.description: Phase difference between the In-phase and Quadrature IF outputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the 90-degree phase shift applied to the LO signals.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Should be close to the ideal 90 degrees, limited only by device mismatches and parasitic asymmetries in the complementary switches.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for Quadrature Mixer measuring Conversion Gain, Power Consumption, and I/Q Phase Difference using a 100 MHz RF and 99.75 MHz LO to produce a 250 kHz IF.
step3_testbench.spice:
* I/Q Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 LABEL_NET_5 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N7 LABEL_NET_6 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 LABEL_NET_8 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 LABEL_NET_9 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 LABEL_NET_10 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N6 LABEL_NET_11 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N5 LABEL_NET_12 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 LABEL_NET_13 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Biasing and Loads
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
R1 N0 VDD 1k
R2 N1 VDD 1k
R3 N6 VDD 1k
R4 N7 VDD 1k

I_N2 N2 0 400u
I_N3 N3 0 400u
I_N8 N8 0 400u

* RF Inputs (100 MHz, 100mV amplitude)
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 100m 100Meg 0 0 0)
VLABEL_NET_8 LABEL_NET_8 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 100m 100Meg 0 0 180)

* LO Inputs (99.75 MHz, 300mV amplitude)
* I-Mixer LO
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 180)
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 0)
VLABEL_NET_9 LABEL_NET_9 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 0)
VLABEL_NET_12 LABEL_NET_12 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 0)

* Q-Mixer LO (90 degree phase shift)
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 270)
VLABEL_NET_10 LABEL_NET_10 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 90)
VLABEL_NET_11 LABEL_NET_11 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 90)
VLABEL_NET_13 LABEL_NET_13 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 300m 99.75Meg 0 0 270)

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

tran 10n 20u
let v_I_diff = v(N0) - v(N1)
let v_Q_diff = v(N7) - v(N6)

* Measure I-channel Conversion Gain
meas tran I_max max v_I_diff from=10u to=20u
meas tran I_min min v_I_diff from=10u to=20u
let I_amp = (I_max - I_min) / 2
let CG_linear = I_amp / 200m
let CG_dB = 20 * log10(CG_linear)
print CG_dB

* Measure Q-channel Conversion Gain
meas tran Q_max max v_Q_diff from=10u to=20u
meas tran Q_min min v_Q_diff from=10u to=20u
let Q_amp = (Q_max - Q_min) / 2
let CG_Q_linear = Q_amp / 200m
let CG_Q_dB = 20 * log10(CG_Q_linear)
print CG_Q_dB

* Measure phase difference between I and Q
meas tran t_I_cross when v_I_diff=0 rise=3
meas tran t_Q_cross when v_Q_diff=0 rise=3
let phase_diff = (t_Q_cross - t_I_cross) * 250k * 360
print phase_diff

quit
.endc
.end
